children: This one gets an all-black look, a darker cabin and purple accents across the Sierra range
Tata Motors has added Dark edition to the Sierra variants, with prices starting at Rs 13.99 lakh.
The Sierra Dark is available across six variants - Pure L, Pure L (O), Pure+ L, Adventure+ L, Accomplished and Accomplished+. It is based on the recently introduced Sierra Legend Series.

The Dark edition focuses mainly on design. The SUV gets a Friesian Black exterior, with purple chrome accents throughout. Inside, the cabin follows the same theme with black leatherette upholstery and a Violet Eclipse colour scheme.

The new edition retains the features and powertrain choices offered with the respective Sierra variants. It is available with the 1.5-litre Revotron petrol, 1.5-litre Kryojet diesel and 1.5-litre Hyperion petrol engines, depending on the variant.

Prices for the Pure L Dark starts at Rs 13.99 lakh for the petrol-manual version, while the diesel-manual variant costs Rs 15.44 lakh. The Pure L (O) is priced from Rs 14.59 lakh and the Pure+ L from Rs 15.29 lakh.

The Adventure+ L starts at Rs 17.29 lakh and goes up to Rs 19.79 lakh, depending on the engine and transmission. The Accomplished is priced from Rs 18.29 lakh, while the top-spec Accomplished+ starts at Rs 20.59 lakh and goes up to Rs 21.59 lakh.
The Dark edition brings the blacked-out treatment to the Sierra while retaining the range of engine and transmission choices available on the standard variants.
